sentences.en: Pantera was formed in 1981 in the Dallas, Texas area by two brothers, drummer Vinny Paul and guitarist Dimebag Darrell.

sentences.en: Prior to the filming of the show, Vinny turned 21 and came on the show to have fun in his first summer being 21-years-old.
